metadata.description: Thes1s custom 3-tier stock market industry taxonomy optimized for Rule One investment research

industries.name: Software - Application
industries.description: Companies developing software for end-user business or consumer applications. Includes ERP, CRM, design, productivity tools.

industries.name: Software - Infrastructure
industries.description: Companies providing systems software, operating systems, database management, middleware, DevOps tools.

industries.name: Software - SaaS & Cloud
industries.description: Companies delivering software primarily via cloud subscription models. Revenue >50% from SaaS subscriptions.

industries.name: Software - Cybersecurity
industries.description: Companies focused on network security, endpoint protection, identity management, threat detection.

industries.name: Software - AI & Machine Learning
industries.description: Companies whose primary product is AI/ML platforms, tools, or services. Revenue >50% from AI-specific products.

industries.name: Consumer Electronics
industries.description: Computers, smartphones, tablets, wearables, and consumer-facing hardware.

industries.name: Computer Hardware & Storage
industries.description: Servers, storage systems, networking hardware, enterprise computing equipment.

industries.name: Communication Equipment
industries.description: Telecom infrastructure equipment, routers, switches, wireless infrastructure.

industries.name: Scientific & Technical Instruments
industries.description: Test, measurement, analytical, and scientific instruments.

industries.name: Semiconductors
industries.description: Companies designing and/or manufacturing integrated circuits, processors, memory chips, GPUs.

industries.name: Semiconductor Equipment & Materials
industries.description: Equipment, tools, and materials used in semiconductor fabrication.

industries.name: Electronic Components
industries.description: Passive and active electronic components: resistors, capacitors, connectors, sensors.

industries.name: Electronic Manufacturing Services
industries.description: Contract electronics manufacturing (EMS), PCB assembly, ODM services.

industries.name: Information Technology Services
industries.description: IT consulting, systems integration, managed services, outsourcing.

industries.name: Internet Services & Infrastructure
industries.description: Web hosting, domain services, CDN, internet backbone providers.

industries.name: Data Processing & Outsourced Services
industries.description: Data processing, payroll services, HR tech, business process outsourcing.

industries.name: Cloud Computing Infrastructure
industries.description: IaaS and PaaS providers. Companies whose primary business is cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP competitors).

industries.name: Technology Distributors
industries.description: Wholesale distribution of technology products and components.

industries.name: Telecom - Diversified
industries.description: Large telecom companies offering wireline, wireless, and broadband services.

industries.name: Telecom - Wireless
industries.description: Pure-play wireless service providers and MVNOs.

industries.name: Telecom - Regional & Rural
industries.description: Regional telephone companies and rural broadband providers.

industries.name: Entertainment - Diversified
industries.description: Diversified media conglomerates with film, TV, theme parks, and/or sports.

industries.name: Entertainment - Streaming
industries.description: Companies whose primary business is streaming video/audio content delivery.

industries.name: Gaming & Interactive Entertainment
industries.description: Video game publishers, developers, esports, interactive entertainment platforms.

industries.name: Broadcasting - TV & Radio
industries.description: Traditional broadcast television and radio station operators.

industries.name: Publishing & Information Services
industries.description: Book, newspaper, magazine publishers and information service providers.

industries.name: Advertising & Marketing Services
industries.description: Advertising agencies, marketing services, PR firms.

industries.name: Internet Content & Information
industries.description: Search engines, web portals, online information services.

industries.name: Social Media Platforms
industries.description: Companies operating social networking platforms as primary business.

industries.name: Digital Advertising Platforms
industries.description: Companies whose primary revenue is from digital advertising technology and platforms.

industries.name: Online Marketplaces
industries.description: Peer-to-peer and B2C marketplace platforms (not direct retail).

industries.name: Auto Manufacturers
industries.description: Traditional internal combustion engine automobile manufacturers.

industries.name: Auto Manufacturers - Electric Vehicles
industries.description: Companies primarily manufacturing electric vehicles. Revenue >50% from EVs.

industries.name: Auto Parts & Equipment
industries.description: Automotive parts, components, and equipment manufacturers.

industries.name: Auto Dealerships
industries.description: New and used vehicle dealership groups.

industries.name: Recreational Vehicles
industries.description: Manufacturers of RVs, ATVs, motorcycles, boats, powersports.

industries.name: Apparel - Athletic & Lifestyle
industries.description: Athletic apparel, activewear, and lifestyle brands. Key competitors: NKE, LULU, UAA, ONON.

industries.name: Apparel - Fashion & Luxury
industries.description: High-end fashion houses, luxury goods, premium accessories.

industries.name: Apparel - Mass Market
industries.description: Casual, everyday apparel brands and manufacturers at mass-market price points.

industries.name: Footwear & Accessories
industries.description: Footwear companies, handbags, jewelry, watches, eyewear.

industries.name: Textile Manufacturing
industries.description: Textile mills, fabric manufacturers, yarn producers.

industries.name: Retail - Broadline & E-Commerce

industries.name: Retail - Specialty
industries.description: Retailers focused on specific product categories (electronics, toys, pets, etc.).

industries.name: Retail - Home Improvement
industries.description: Home improvement and building materials retailers. HD, LOW.

industries.name: Retail - Discount & Dollar Stores
industries.description: Off-price, discount, and dollar store chains. DLTR, DG, TJX, ROST.

industries.name: Retail - Apparel & Accessories
industries.description: Apparel-focused retail chains and stores.

industries.name: Lodging & Resorts
industries.description: Hotels, resorts, timeshare, and lodging companies.

industries.name: Restaurants & Dining

industries.name: Travel & Booking Services
industries.description: Online travel agencies, booking platforms, travel tech.

industries.name: Leisure Products & Activities

industries.description: Casino operators, sports betting, lottery, and gaming companies.

industries.name: Homebuilders
industries.description: Residential home construction companies.

industries.name: Building Products

industries.name: Furnishings & Home Décor
industries.description: Furniture, home furnishing, and décor manufacturers and retailers.

industries.name: Personal Services
industries.description: Personal care services, pet services, funeral services.

industries.name: Education & Training Services
industries.description: For-profit education, training, and certification companies.

industries.name: Beverages - Non-Alcoholic
industries.description: Soft drinks, water, juice, coffee, tea, energy drinks.

industries.name: Beverages - Alcoholic
industries.description: Beer, wine, spirits producers and distributors.

industries.name: Food - Packaged & Processed
industries.description: Packaged food, frozen food, canned goods, snacks, confections.

industries.name: Food - Meat & Dairy
industries.description: Meat processing, dairy producers, poultry companies.

industries.name: Household Products
industries.description: Cleaning products, paper products, home care brands.

industries.name: Personal Products & Cosmetics
industries.description: Personal care, beauty, cosmetics, skincare.

industries.name: Tobacco
industries.description: Cigarettes, cigars, smokeless tobacco, and nicotine products.

industries.name: Retail - Grocery & Supermarkets
industries.description: Grocery chains, supermarkets, natural/organic food retailers.

industries.name: Retail - Warehouse & Club

industries.name: Retail - Pharmacy & Drug Stores

industries.name: Agricultural Products & Processing

industries.name: Agricultural Inputs

industries.name: Drug Manufacturers - Major
industries.description: Large-cap pharmaceutical companies with diversified drug portfolios.

industries.name: Drug Manufacturers - Specialty & Generic
industries.description: Specialty pharma, generic drug makers, and niche therapeutics.

industries.name: Biotechnology
industries.description: Companies using biological processes to develop drugs, therapies, and diagnostics.

industries.name: Medical Devices
industries.description: Manufacturers of medical devices, implants, surgical instruments.

industries.name: Medical Instruments & Supplies
industries.description: Medical supplies, disposables, diagnostic equipment, lab instruments.

industries.name: Healthcare Providers & Facilities
industries.description: Hospitals, clinics, outpatient care centers, nursing facilities.

industries.name: Health Information Technology

industries.name: Healthcare Plans & Insurance
industries.description: Health insurance companies, managed care organizations, PBMs.

industries.name: Medical Distribution

industries.name: Diagnostics & Research
industries.description: Diagnostic testing companies, clinical laboratories, CROs.

industries.name: Life Science Tools & Services
industries.description: Lab equipment, reagents, genomics tools, analytical instruments for life sciences.

industries.name: Banks - Diversified
industries.description: Large national/global banks with diversified financial services.

industries.name: Banks - Regional
industries.description: Regional and super-regional banks operating in specific geographies.

industries.name: Banks - Community & Thrift
industries.description: Small community banks, savings institutions, credit unions (public).

industries.name: Insurance - Life
industries.description: Life insurance, annuities, retirement products.

industries.name: Insurance - Property & Casualty
industries.description: Property, casualty, auto, homeowners insurance.

industries.name: Insurance - Specialty
industries.description: Specialty lines: title, mortgage, surety, professional liability.

industries.name: Insurance - Reinsurance
industries.description: Reinsurance companies providing insurance to insurers.

industries.name: Insurance Brokers & Services
industries.description: Insurance brokerage, distribution, and related services.

industries.name: Asset Management
industries.description: Investment management, mutual funds, ETF providers, wealth management.

industries.name: Investment Banking & Brokerage
industries.description: Investment banks, broker-dealers, securities firms.

industries.name: Financial Exchanges & Data
industries.description: Stock exchanges, derivatives exchanges, financial data and analytics providers.

industries.name: Private Equity & Venture Capital
industries.description: Publicly traded PE firms, VC firms, alternative asset managers.

industries.name: Credit Services & Lending
industries.description: Consumer lending, student loans, personal finance, credit cards.

industries.name: Financial Data & Services
industries.description: Financial technology infrastructure, ratings agencies, analytics.

industries.name: Transaction & Payment Processing
industries.description: Payment networks, card processors, merchant services. V, MA, PYPL.

industries.name: Consumer Finance
industries.description: Consumer finance companies, auto lending, lease financing.

industries.name: Fintech - Digital Payments
industries.description: Digital payment platforms, mobile wallets, P2P payment apps.

industries.name: Fintech - Digital Banking & Neobanks
industries.description: Digital-first banks, challenger banks, banking-as-a-service platforms.

industries.name: Fintech - Lending Platforms
industries.description: Online lending platforms, BNPL providers, marketplace lending.

industries.name: Fintech - Blockchain & Crypto
industries.description: Cryptocurrency exchanges, blockchain infrastructure, digital asset companies.

industries.name: Financial Conglomerates
industries.description: Diversified financial holding companies with multiple business lines. BRK, GS (if diversified).

industries.name: Aerospace & Defense

industries.name: Space & Satellite

industries.name: Electrical Equipment
industries.description: Electrical systems, power equipment, wiring, lighting, motors.

industries.name: Metal Fabrication

industries.name: Farm & Heavy Construction Machinery
industries.description: Manufacturers of agricultural equipment, farm machinery, heavy construction equipment (excavators, bulldozers, cranes).

industries.name: Tools & Accessories
industries.description: Manufacturers of hand tools, power tools, and tool accessories for professional and consumer use.

industries.name: Airlines

industries.name: Railroads

industries.name: Oil & Gas - Midstream

industries.name: Oil & Gas - Equipment & Services

industries.name: Oil & Gas - Drilling

industries.name: Solar Energy

industries.name: Wind Energy

industries.name: Renewable Energy Equipment

industries.name: Hydrogen & Fuel Cells

industries.name: Batteries & Energy Storage

industries.name: Coal & Consumable Fuels

industries.name: Chemicals - Specialty

industries.name: Chemicals - Diversified
